class.name: IfcVoidingFeature
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: A voiding feature is a modification of an element which reduces its volume. Such a feature may be manufactured in different ways, for example by cutting, drilling, or milling of members made of various materials, or by inlays into the formwork of cast members made of materials such as concrete. The standard use of instances of IfcVoidingFeature is as a part of element type obj

members.member: Qualifies the feature regarding its shape and configuration relative to the voided element.
